fileLogLevel_comment: Writes stryker.log next to this file, so a failed run can be diagnosed from disk.
ignoreStatic_comment: Kept off on purpose: static mutants here include the injectable's providedIn, so ignoring them would hide them from the 100% floor.
mutate_comment: Scoped to src/lib, the same folder vitest.config.ts measures coverage on. Spec files live next to the source, so they are excluded explicitly; src/test-helpers and the public-api barrel are out of scope. The sibling keystone-financial-tools-core is not mutated.
thresholds_comment: Any survivor fails the run: the floor is 100% (timed-out mutants count as detected). Never lower `break`.
